preconditions.description: The number of students is between 1 and 1000, inclusive.
Each student's report is a valid student number.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n integers.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= output_i <= n for output_i in output)
postconditions.description: Each output integer is a valid student number between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: all(output[a-1] == find_student_with_two_holes(a, p) for a in range(1, n+1))
postconditions.description: For each student a, the output[a-1] is the student who would receive two holes in the badge if a was the first student caught by the teacher.
